autotune_triton_config: autotune a triton kernel config using coordinate descent to find the fastest configuration
check_all_tuning_directions: check all tuning directions to find improvements after greedy coordinate descent converges
compare_triton_configs: compare two triton kernel configs by benchmarking and returning the faster one
get_neighbour_values: get neighbour values for a tunable field by doubling or halving around the current value
call_benchmark_func: call a benchmark function with a triton config using cached results to avoid redundant runs
